title: Ores-B-Gone [OBG]
description: Blends all ores into stone, deepslate, and netherrack. Designed to be fully compatible with any other resource pack!
body:
# ⛏️ Ores-B-Gone!

**The ultimate ore-camouflaging resource pack.**

Have you ever wanted to make mining a true challenge? Or perhaps you need to hide valuable resources from prying eyes? **Ores-B-Gone** is a lightweight, seamless resource pack that completely hides all ores by blending them perfectly into their natural surroundings.

---

### 🌟 The Main Feature: 100% Compatibility

The most powerful aspect of this pack is its **universal compatibility**. It doesn't matter if you play with the default Vanilla look, a high-resolution realistic pack.

* **Dynamic Adaptation:** Ores-B-Gone automatically inherits the base textures of whatever resource pack you are currently using.
* **How to Apply:** Simply place **Ores-B-Gone** at the **TOP** of your active resource packs list in the game menu, and it will do the rest!

### 🛠️ What it Does

This pack takes every single ore in the game and replaces its texture with the exact texture of its base block, effectively making them invisible:

* **Stone Ores** (Coal, Iron, Copper, Gold, Redstone, Lapis Lazuli, Diamond, Emerald) look exactly like **Stone**.
* **Deepslate Ores** (Coal, Iron, Copper, Gold, Redstone, Lapis Lazuli, Diamond, Emerald) look exactly like **Deepslate**.
* **Nether Ores** (Quartz, Nether Gold, Ancient Debris, Gilded Blackstone) disguise themselves as regular **Netherrack And Blackstone** (only for Gilded Blackstone).

### 🎯 Perfect For...

* **Hardcore Challenges with Friends:** Try beating the game or hosting a mining race when you can't tell a diamond apart from a regular rock!
* **Server Admins:** An excellent, natural way to obscure ores or hide underground player bases that are built out of valuable blocks without relying on heavy server plugins.
* **Content Creators & YouTubers:** It's crucial for protecting your base coordinates. Streams and videos often accidentally leak base locations because viewers can recognize unique ore patterns etc. With this pack, your surroundings look like ordinary stone, keeping your coordinates 100% safe.

---

**Note:** This pack changes textures only. The blocks still retain their original breaking times, sounds, and drops. Happy (blind) mining!
